title: Geometric Relevance Is Not Sufficient: Evaluating Focused Post-Training Supervision in Diffusion Docking
abstract: arXiv:2611.08249v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion-based molecular docking requires learning a corrective score field across a broad corruption distribution, yet individual pose errors can differ substantially in their structural consequences. This creates a post-training conflict between preserving broad score-field coverage and concentrating supervision on corrections that appear more relevant to docking geometry. Using DiffDock, a fixed-budget study compares broad continuation with torsional supervision focused on Cartesian consequence or conditional target consistency, and with a broad/focused mixture. Evaluation separates fixed score fidelity, generated-pose quality, best-of-10 sampling capacity, and confidence-selected Top-1 docking performance. At <5 Angstrom, broad continuation had the highest mean Top-1 success among trained policies, and focused or mixed supervision showed no consistent advantage under the tested budget. The starting model had better fixed score fidel

translated_title: 几何相关性并不足够：评估扩散对接中的聚焦式后训练监督
translated_abstract: 基于扩散的分子对接需要学习一个跨越广泛损坏分布的校正得分场，然而单个姿态误差在结构后果上可能差异巨大。这在“保持广泛的得分场覆盖”与“将监督集中于与对接几何更相关的校正”之间造成了后训练上的冲突。本研究使用DiffDock进行固定预算实验，比较了广泛的延续训练与聚焦于笛卡尔后果或条件目标一致性的扭转监督，以及广泛/聚焦混合方案。评估将固定得分保真度、生成姿态质量、最优10次采样能力以及基于置信度选择的Top-1对接性能分开考量。在小于5埃的阈值下，广泛延续训练在受训策略中拥有最高的平均Top-1成功率，而聚焦式或混合监督在所测试的预算下并未显示出一致的优势。起始模型具有更好的固定得分保真度……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过固定预算实验发现，在DiffDock扩散分子对接的后训练中，聚焦于几何相关校正的监督策略相比广泛的延续训练并无一致优势，广泛的延续训练反而取得了最高的Top-1对接成功率。
en_tdlr: A fixed-budget study on DiffDock shows that focused post-training supervision on geometrically relevant corrections offers no consistent advantage over broad continuation, which achieves the highest Top-1 docking success rate.
